esp_bridge_outdated.title: ESP bridge firmware update required
esp_bridge_outdated.description:
Your ESP bridge is running **v{version}**, but **v{min_version}** or newer is required for full functionality.

Rebuild and flash your ESPHome device to get the latest firmware.

See the ESP Bridge Setup Guide in the integration documentation for details.

standalone_card_installed.title: Standalone Philips Shaver Card is still installed
standalone_card_installed.description:
The Philips Shaver Card now ships with this integration and no longer needs to be installed separately.

A standalone copy of the card is still registered as a dashboard resource (`{url}`). Both copies register the same card element and only one of them wins, so the standalone copy can silently shadow the bundled, up-to-date card.

Please remove the standalone installation:

1. If installed via HACS: open HACS, find *Philips Shaver Card* and uninstall it (this also removes the dashboard resource).
2. If added manually: delete the resource under *Settings → Dashboards → Resources* and remove the file from your `www` folder.

Your dashboards keep working unchanged — the bundled card uses the same `custom:philips-shaver-card` type.

esp_bridge_idf_bond_loss.title: Philips Shaver: ESP bridge {esp_device} loses pairings (ESP-IDF {idf_version})
esp_bridge_idf_bond_loss.description:
The **Philips Shaver** integration found that its ESP bridge **{esp_device}** runs firmware built with ESP-IDF **{idf_version}**, the default of ESPHome 2026.10.0. This ESP-IDF version has a Bluetooth bug: after the first disconnect, the bridge forgets the pairing with your shaver until the ESP restarts. The shaver then refuses the new pairing attempt, and the bridge eventually drops its copy of the pairing, so only unpairing on the shaver helps.

**To fix:** pin ESP-IDF 5.5.5 in the bridge's YAML, then rebuild and flash it:

```yaml
esp32:
  framework:
    type: esp-idf
    version: 5.5.5
```

This warning clears automatically once the bridge runs firmware built with a different ESP-IDF version.

data_description.notify_throttle_ms: Minimum interval between BLE notification events forwarded by the ESP bridge (in milliseconds). Lower values give faster updates but may overload the ESP API buffer. Only applies to ESP32 bridge connections.
data_description.pipelined_reads: Send the poll cycle's GATT reads to the ESP bridge as one batch instead of one at a time (much faster reconnects). Requires bridge firmware 1.10.0 or newer — on older firmware reads always stay sequential, regardless of this setting. Disable only if you see repeated read timeouts or ATT watchdog messages in the bridge logs. Only applies to ESP32 bridge connections.

adapter.title: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.description: Choose the local Bluetooth adapter the shaver connects through. If the new adapter needs a pairing first, that follows in the next step.

data_description.bluetooth_adapter: The local adapter the shaver connects through — only through that one: if it does not receive the shaver, there is no connection. The shaver keeps only one pairing, so it connects through one fixed adapter; there is no automatic switching. Each adapter needs its own pairing; if the chosen one has none yet, pairing follows in the next step. When you switch adapters, the shaver's pairings on the other local adapters are removed. Bluetooth proxies are not listed — they cannot pair with Philips shavers. Signal strength is shown for adapters that receive the shaver right now.

pair_adapter.title: Pair Bluetooth adapter
pair_adapter.description:
{alert}The shaver is not paired with **{adapter}** yet. Each Bluetooth adapter needs its own pairing — paired so far with: **{paired_on}**.

The shaver keeps only one pairing at a time and rejects a new adapter while it still holds the old one:

1. **Reset Bluetooth on the shaver itself** — model-specific, see the [unpairing guide]({unpairing_url}). Removing it from a phone or app is not enough.
2. Place the shaver close to **{adapter}** and **switch it on** (press the power button or place it on its charging stand).
3. Click **Submit** right away. The integration is paused while this dialog is open and resumes when it closes.

progress.pair_adapter: Waiting for the shaver on **{adapter}**, then pairing — keep it switched on and close to the adapter. This can take up to two minutes…

error.pair_adapter_failed:
Pairing with {adapter} failed: {error}

If the shaver still holds its previous pairing, it rejects the new adapter — reset Bluetooth on the shaver as described in step 1, switch it on and click Submit to try again. Or close this dialog to keep the previous settings.
error.pair_adapter_no_advertisement:
{adapter} did not receive the shaver within {seconds} seconds. After a disconnect the shaver often stays silent until it is switched on again.

Place it close to {adapter}, switch it on, then click Submit right away — or close this dialog to keep the previous settings.
error.pair_adapter_weak: {adapter} receives the shaver only weakly ({rssi} dBm) — pairing may time out. Bring the shaver closer to {adapter}.
error.headline_adapter: **Bluetooth adapter changed.** From now on the shaver connects only through **{adapter}**.
error.headline_adapter_same: **Bluetooth adapter confirmed.** The shaver keeps connecting only through **{adapter}**.
error.summary_pair_unknown: 🔲 **{adapter}**: pairing not checked — adapter or Bluetooth service not available right now
error.summary_drop_failed: ❌ **{adapter}**: old pairing could not be removed — see the log
error.summary_drop_none: 🔲 **Other adapters**: no old pairings to remove
error.summary_drop_unknown: 🔲 **Other adapters**: not checked — Bluetooth service not available right now
error.summary_reload: ✅ **Integration**: reloading — the shaver reconnects as soon as it is switched on.
error.summary_drop_unverified: ⚠️ **Other adapters**: pairings kept — the shaver is not connected right now, so it cannot be checked which pairing is valid. Switch the shaver on and choose this adapter again to remove the others.

user_bleak.title: Direct Bluetooth
user_bleak.description:
Select your shaver from the list of discovered devices, or choose “Other” to enter its Bluetooth MAC address manually.

**Important:** switch the shaver on (press the power button or place it on its charging stand) before clicking Submit — it must stay on so its services can be read.

request_pair.title: Pair shaver to ESP bridge
request_pair.description:
{notice}Bridge **{target}** has no shaver bonded yet.

1. Make sure the shaver is **turned on** and **not connected to your phone** (remove it from Bluetooth settings and the GroomTribe / OneBlade app).
2. Place the shaver close to the bridge.
3. Click **Start pairing** below — the bridge will scan for **60 seconds**. Trigger the shaver's BLE-advertise mode (model-specific: hold the power button or place it on the charging stand).

Once the bond is established you'll return to the bridge status screen — finish setup there with **Read capabilities**.

reset_bridge.title: Reset bridge bond
reset_bridge.description:
{error}Slot **{target}** is currently bonded to **{identity_address}**.

Clicking **Unpair and reset** will remove the BLE bond on the bridge and clear the saved identity. After that you can pair a different shaver.

The shaver keeps its own half of the bond. If pairing this same shaver again later fails with repeated auth errors, reset Bluetooth on the shaver itself first (model-specific, see the unpairing guide; unpairing in the GroomTribe / OneBlade app is not enough).

not_paired_proxy.title: Pairing Required
not_paired_proxy.description:
{alert}**{address}** requires **BLE bonding** before it can be read — and on this connection the pairing cannot succeed.

Working alternatives:

1. Set the shaver up via a **local Bluetooth adapter** on the Home Assistant host.
2. Use the dedicated **ESP32 bridge** (see the integration documentation).

If a local adapter is also in range, move the shaver closer to it and click **Retry** — with “Automatic”, Home Assistant connects through the local adapter that receives the shaver best; with a fixed adapter, only through that one.

data_description.device_name: How this shaver appears in Home Assistant. Pick something that distinguishes it from any other shavers you have (e.g., "Bathroom", "John's").

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the shaver. Please ensure it is powered on, in range, and not connected to another device (e.g. your phone).
error.caps_note_groomer_oneblade_only: ❌ The Smart Groomer service is only available on OneBlade / QP models.
error.caps_note_not_on_oneblade: ❌ Control and Serial/Diagnostic services are not present on OneBlade models — this is expected.
error.confirm_alert_aborted: The connection was aborted — the shaver may be out of range, or the connection went through an unsupported standard Bluetooth proxy. Move the shaver closer to a local Bluetooth adapter, then click Read capabilities again.
error.confirm_alert_asleep: The shaver is asleep — wake it (press the power button or place it on its charging stand), then click Read capabilities again.
error.confirm_alert_failed: Could not read the shaver. Make sure it is switched on and in range, then click Read capabilities to try again. Details are in the logs (Settings → System → Logs).
error.confirm_warn_proxy: This connection would go through the Bluetooth proxy {proxy_name}{proxy_rssi}.{nl}Philips shavers cannot pair over a standard Bluetooth proxy — setup and live updates over this path will fail.{nl}Set the shaver up via a local Bluetooth adapter or the dedicated ESP32 bridge instead.
error.connection_aborted: Connection was aborted. The device may be out of range or connected through an unsupported Bluetooth proxy. This integration requires direct Bluetooth or the dedicated ESP32 BLE bridge — standard ESPHome Bluetooth Proxies are not supported.
error.device_asleep: The shaver is asleep. Wake it (press the power button or place it on its charging stand), then try again.
error.device_not_found: Device not found. Please ensure it is powered on and in range.
error.esp_status_no_diagnostics: ⚠️ Diagnostic details not available. Consider updating the ESP bridge component.
error.esp_status_paired: Pairing successful — the bridge is now bonded to your shaver.
error.esp_status_read_error: Something went wrong reading the shaver. Check the logs (Settings → System → Logs) and try again.
error.esp_status_read_failed: Couldn't read the shaver over the bridge. Make sure it's switched on and the bridge is online, then try again.
error.no_esphome_devices: No ESPHome devices found. Please set up an ESPHome device with the BLE bridge component first. See the ESP Bridge Setup Guide in the integration documentation for instructions.
error.not_paired: The shaver is not paired with this system.
error.not_paired_proxy_dead_end: This connection runs through the standard Bluetooth proxy {proxy_name}. Philips shavers pair via LE Secure Connections, which a standard Bluetooth proxy cannot complete — pairing over this path will not succeed, and pairing tools on the Home Assistant host have no effect on it.
error.out_of_slots: No Bluetooth adapter could reach the device. Either all connection slots are in use, or the device is out of range. Ensure the shaver is powered on and close to the Bluetooth adapter, and try removing unused Bluetooth devices if needed.
error.pair_failed_stale_bond: Pairing failed with repeated auth errors. The shaver still holds the previous pairing on its side and rejects a new one. Reset Bluetooth on the shaver itself (model-specific, see the unpairing guide; unpairing in the GroomTribe / OneBlade app is not enough), then retry.
error.pair_status_unpaired: Bond removed — the slot is free. Switch on the shaver you want to bond, then start pairing.
error.pair_timeout: No shaver appeared during the 60-second pair-mode window. Make sure the shaver is on and advertising, and try again.
error.pair_timeout_passive_scanner:
**No shaver appeared during the 60-second pair-mode window.** The bridge **scanned passively** the whole time, so it could not see the shaver at all — a passive scan never asks for the scan response that carries the shaver's service UUID.

**What to do:** set this ESPHome device's Bluetooth scanning mode to **Active** under `Settings > Devices & Services > ESPHome > Configure`, then try again.
error.pairing_failed: Bluetooth pairing failed. Make sure the shaver is switched on and not connected to another device (phone / GroomTribe / OneBlade app). If it keeps failing, the shaver still holds an old pairing on its side — reset Bluetooth on the shaver itself (model-specific, see the unpairing guide; unpairing in the app is not enough), then retry.
error.reset_alert_offline: Couldn't reach the ESP bridge to clear the bond. Make sure it's online and powered, then try again.
error.reset_alert_unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the bridge cleared the bond — it may need a reboot. Make sure it's online, then try again.
error.service_call_failed: Could not arm pair-mode on the ESP bridge. The bridge may be offline or a too-old firmware version. Update the bridge to v1.8.0 or newer and retry.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs (Settings → System → Logs) for details.
error.adapter_not_receiving: The selected Bluetooth adapter does not receive the shaver right now. Switch the shaver on and bring it within range of that adapter, or choose another adapter.
error.confirm_alert_adapter: The selected Bluetooth adapter does not receive the shaver right now. Switch the shaver on and bring it within range of that adapter, or choose another adapter.
error.pair_not_found: The Bluetooth adapter did not find the shaver for pairing. Switch the shaver on, bring it close to the adapter and try again.
